transcript.content: `types.singleton()` misleading / incorrect error https://play.luau.org/# The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed (Luau), find the implementation of types.singleton (type function library), likely in Analysis/src/UserDefinedTypeFunction.cpp or TypeFunctionRuntime.cpp. Print the function body and the error message it throws.

content.content: {"summary":"types.singleton is implemented as the C function createSingleton in TypeFunctionRuntime.cpp. It returns a boolean singleton for booleans, a string singleton for strings, and a nil primitive for nil. Any other argument type raises a Lua error with the message below. It is registered in the type library table as {\"singleton\", createSingleton} at line 1892.","findings":["Analysis/src/TypeFunctionRuntime.cpp:507-536: static int createSingleton(lua_State* L) — the function body (no edits made).","Analysis/src/TypeFunctionRuntime.cpp:511-517: boolean branch, uses lua_isboolean/luaL_checkboolean and allocTypeUserData(TypeFunctionSingletonType{TypeFunctionBooleanSingleton{value}}).","Analysis/src/TypeFunctionRuntime.cpp:520-526: string branch, checks lua_type(L,1)==LUA_TSTRING (not lua_isstring, per the comment about numbers), then luaL_checkstring and allocates TypeFunctionStringSingleton.","Analysis/src/TypeFunctionRuntime.cpp:528-532: nil branch allocates TypeFunctionPrimitiveType::NilType.","Analysis/src/TypeFunctionRuntime.cpp:535: error message: \"types.singleton: can't create singleton from `%s` type\", formatted with lua_typename(L, 1), raised via luaL_error.","Analysis/src/TypeFunctionRuntime.cpp:1892: registration {\"singleton\", createSingleton}."],"confidence":0.95}

content.text: Bug: lua_typename(L,1) takes a type tag, not index.

input.instruction: In /testbed check that luaL_typename macro exists in VM/include/lualib.h (grep). Report only yes/no.

content.content: {"summary":"no","findings":["VM/include/lualib.h:61 declares `LUALIB_API const char* luaL_typename(lua_State* L, int idx);` as a function prototype. No `#define luaL_typename` macro was found in that file."],"confidence":0.9}
